neighbours.label: Statements about God or Christ in scripture or doctrine, on a word in the telling ('God created man in his own', 'Cast all', 'in whom He takes'); the same frames about people and firms, and church life without God in the frame, stay low.
fire: Then God formed the heavens with his own hands.
The psalm urges, "Lay all your burdens on the Lord, for He sustains you."
The Lord chose Zion, in whom He delights forever.
God gave Abraham and Sarah a son in their old age.
Paul writes that every gift of God is holy.
In John's prologue, Christ is called the Word of life.
Scripture says that God breathed life into Adam.
The Lord made a covenant with Noah and all his sons.
quiet: Then Apple formed the board with its own lawyers.
The memo urges, "Put all your receipts on the desk, for he checks them."
The firm chose Denver, where it opens offices soon.
The bank gave Andrew and Sarah a loan in their old age.
Our church bus has a leak in the back.
In John's office, the clerk is called the head of sales.
The bulletin says that the choir built a stage in Ohio.
The mayor made a deal with Nora and all her staff.

notes: Probes: 0.50-0.91, but 'made from the dust of the earth' 0.02, without God in the frame. Same frames about a boss or a firm 0.00-0.15. Peak tokens are varied and often function words. Whether it is scripture or God-talk in general isn't separated; two near misses keep a church setting without God.
